review_note: Five shared chainstate disk replay diagnostics; existing block hash and height fields only.

rules.old:
LogError("ReplayBlock(): ReadBlock failed at %d, hash=%s\n",
                 pindex->nHeight, pindex->GetBlockHash().ToString())
rules.replacement:
LogErrorEvent(BCLog::ALL, "chain_replay_read_failed",
            "ReplayBlock(): ReadBlock failed at {height}, hash={block_hash}")
            .Field(BCLog::LogField::Height, pindex->nHeight)
            .Field(BCLog::LogField::BlockHash, pindex->GetBlockHash())
rules.review_note: Preserve original Error/Info severity, ALL category, readable text, argument order and replay/rollback control flow. Height copies the same integer; BlockHash and TxId copy the original GetBlockHash/GetId rather than producer-side ToString. Transaction identifier is GetId (never GetHash); no replay, undo, fee or UTXO logic is changed. Existing fields/API only. V2 undo diagnostics belong after3c491043cec (Original-Patch v2/030); shared replay sites belong in the shared tier.
